facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_七杀 (Metal carrying The General). Persona The General (七杀). Definition line: "Pressure that doesn't grant permission, the trial that forges". Keyword Force, charge fierce, poles catalyst Command / friction Harshness. Family function: Order. Cost dimension: pressure that does not ask permission; peace can feel like demotion. Arena: forge, campaign, the weight of command, tempering. Classical portrait: pressure as clarity; the trial that forges; force without permission; peace felt as demotion. Ruled domains: Pressure, Command, Crisis. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正官.
Element arena: Metal (edge, blade, ore, forge, whetstone, the clean line). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Wood. structural_interaction seed: "Metal pressing Wood same-polarity — the cutting force that doesn't grant permission".
- k2_overview: "Your Metal moves as the General: edge given rank. Pressure organizes you, crisis promotes you, and your will cuts through what committees cannot. This is the sword in its born office, decisive, disciplined, feared a little and needed often. Command the campaigns worth blood. Sheathe everywhere else."
- k2_functional: "Your rules are field orders: few, absolute, and enforced first on your own conduct."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Punishing","Ruthless","Blunted"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Pressure":"Pressure is your forge: you harden correctly under loads that crack others. Seek arenas with real stakes. Comfort dulls you faster than any enemy could.","Command":"Command fits you like a sword fits its grip: natural, tested, dangerous if idle. Take charge where the mission deserves it, and practice the harder art, releasing command without losing edge.","Crisis":"In crisis you become simple and effective: triage, decision, stroke. People will remember your calm longer than the emergency. Keep one habit for after: cleaning the blade, debriefing the heart."}
- fn_reading.catalyst.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.catalyst; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 金_正官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Precise","Incorruptible","Even-handed"],"friction":["Demanding","Unbending","By-the-book"]}
- Sibling cell 金_正官 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Exactness is your dialect. The estimate lands within percent, the summary contains nothing loose, the drawer holds what its label claims. Around you, vagueness feels briefly embarrassed of itself, and work passing through your hands comes out true to measure, every time it matters."

Core element Wood, energy element Metal. Law: Metal tames Wood (金克木: the knife prunes the branch). Relative to the core the energy is the tamer, so Metal is this core's Order. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Wood core that shows Metal on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Metal as the Order is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 木_金's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Taking charge comes to you before anyone asks. A crisis gives your force a charge to carry, and you carry it yourself rather than wait for someone else to step up. Let someone else take charge sometimes, since always leading means never being carried.

value_b.text: You take charge the moment something starts going wrong. Being in charge gives your push a direction, and you reach for it ahead of comfort every time. Let the calm after count too, because every charge you take costs you some rest.

value.text: Pressure is where you do your best work. A real stake lets you thrive where comfort lets you drift, and being tested suits you better than being at ease. Keep thriving on it, and notice that nothing without pressure gets the same care.

value_b.text: You thrive under pressure the way others thrive on praise. Pressure shapes your force, and that is why you take the harder task ahead of the easy one. Enjoy that, and know an easy season with no pressure feels like a loss.

value.text: Deciding fast is how you stop a crisis from deciding for you. A quick decision points your push somewhere, and you accept being wrong early rather than being right too late. Keep the speed, and give one slow decision its day sometimes.

value_b.text: You decide fast because being wrong sits easier with you than waiting. One firm decision gives your push the shape it was waiting for. Trust that, and let the full picture catch up before the next decision.

value.text: Fast decisions are the ones you trust. Deciding quickly keeps you ahead of the crisis, and you take the first good option rather than the best. Sleep on one decision a month, because the better option you never saw is what speed costs you.
